Engagement Details
Our client is an VC-funded early-stage US-based startup with an ambitious vision to revolutionize the Real Estate space with a solution allowing homeowners to sell their homes by themselves.

Our client is on a mission to eliminate the $100B homeowners lose each year to real estate commissions. We're building the first AI-powered home-selling platform that empowers homeowners to sell without real estate agents, replacing outdated systems and middlemen with smarter, more transparent tools. With strong early traction and backing from top investors, we’re creating a radically better home-selling experience, and we’re looking for a founding full stack engineer to help architect, scale, and shape the future of the company.
The Role

We’re looking for a Founding Full Stack Engineer who thrives in a fast-paced environment and wants to build a category-defining product from the ground up. You’ll work directly with the CEO and founding team to design and deliver a high-trust, AI-first experience across web and cloud infrastructure. This role is perfect for someone who’s deeply hands-on but also thinks strategically about architecture, scalability, and speed.
What You’ll Do
ul
li
Own architecture and implementation across the stack—from frontend to backend to infrastructure
Build fast, responsive, and intuitive UIs using React, Next.js, Tailwind, and Bootstrap
Develop robust backend services with Node.js and Express
Design and scale cloud infrastructure using AWS (CDK, CloudFront, API Gateway, DynamoDB, Lambda, SQS, SNS, Bedrock, S3, EC2, Fargate)
Partner closely with product, design, and legal to launch secure and scalable features
Contribute to DevOps, CI/CD, and infrastructure automation as we grow.

Please note: As an early team member, you’ll have the opportunity to move fast, take ownership, and help build a game-changing product —this is more than just 9 to 5. This is a high-growth opportunity where you'll be expected to bring your best —long hours, high energy, and fast execution are part of the journey.

What are your typical clients?

The majority of our clients are venture-backed startups at the growth stage. Usually, at this stage, the company already achieved a product-market fit and is looking to expand rapidly. What is the length of your engagements?
Most of our long-term full-time engagements last multiple years. It allows you to evolve your career with the client company taking on more responsibilities.
What’s your company size?

The Right Balance team is 55+ engineers going to 75+ by the end of the year. The current client size team is 3+ people. The timing is great to be a part of a rapidly growing team making meaningful contributions.
